Name: Demetrius Visits Farm Cave Redux
Author: atravita
Description:
Makes Demetrius visit his little experiment in the farm cave sometimes. Also gives him 80+ lines of dialogue to use, consisting mostly of science facts, dad jokes, and the occasional rant about Reviewer 2.

Demetrius will either come visit once per week or once per month, depending on settings. You can restrict him to only coming on days that are winter or raining, when otherwise he'd be indoors all day. If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5176]Non Destructive NPCs[/url] installed, he'll leave at 4PM, going to the Saloon on Fridays and home on any other day. Otherwise, he'll be there all day. This is because the default Stardew scheduler will not prevent NPCs from walking straight through and breaking the mushroom boxes, so if you don't have Non Destructive NPCs installed, he won't be allowed to move around.

Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5477?tab=description]Demetrius Visits Cave[/url].

Also, much thanks to the [url=https://www.pbs.org/show/eons/]PBS Eons[/url] team, who inspired this mod, and whose show was on the background for basically the entire time I was writing this.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]

[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=monospace]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[b][size=5]Uninstall[/size][/b]

Simply remove this mod from your mods folder.

[b][size=5]Configuration[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][b]DemetriusVisitDay[/b]: Select which day Demetrius comes to the farm cave. If you select a day of week, he comes once per week. If you select a specific day, he comes once per month. Specific schedules (like his night market schedule or his hospital visit) will still take priority though. (Custom NPC Exclusions is used to prevent him from trying to go to Ginger Island.). Defaults to Tuesday.
[i]SVE Note:[/i] Community Day takes priority over a Tuesday setting in this mod, and I wouldn't recommend setting this mod to the 22nd if you have SVE. Otherwise should be perfectly compatible. [*][b]OnlyIfRainingOrWinter[/b]: Will limit Demetrius to only visiting during the winter or during days where it's raining, when he'd stay inside otherwise. (Most of his other schedules have him wandering around town or studying the river in the mountains.)
[*][b]OverrideUnlock[/b]: Demetrius should start visiting after the farm cave is unlocked, but if that doesn't work for some reason, set this to true.
[*][b]OverrideMovement[/b]: Allows Demetrius to wander around even if a non-destructive NPC mod is not detected, but he may destroy things.

[*][b]EnableDialogue[/b]: Enables the dialogue this mod adds.
[*][b]XPosition/YPosition[/b]: Sets the location Demetrius should stand in.
[*][b]XWarp/YWarp[/b]: Sets the location Demetrius should leave the farm cave from. This should be set one square away from the actual exit. You probably don't need to change this.
[/list]
